Temperament List

Create the temperaments used by Enitoy. Rows show the stat raised by 10%; columns show the stat lowered by 10%. Each stat combination can be used only once.

Raised ↓
Lowered →		 Attack Defense Sp. Attack Sp. Defense Speed

Temperaments do not affect HP and are included when you use Export Project.

Skills List

Create the skills currently present in Enitoy. Skills are automatically displayed in alphabetical order.

Skill Effect Actions

Skills are included when you use Export Project.

Defects List

Create the Defect effects that can appear on Misprint Enitoy. Defects are automatically displayed in alphabetical order.

Defect Effect Actions

Defects are stored separately from Skills and are included when you use Export Project.

Item List

Create the items currently present in Enitoy. Items are ordered by Pocket number, then alphabetically within each Pocket.

Name Plural Name Buy Price Sell Price Pocket Description Actions

Items are stored separately and are included when you use Export Project.

Crafts List

Create crafting recipes using only items that currently exist in the Item List.

Result Method Components Actions

Recipes can use the Crafting Station or an Enitoy holding an Item and using a move of a required Stitching. Every referenced Item must exist in the Item List. Crafts are included when you use Export Project.

Regional

Generation tabs and their Enitoy slots are included when you use Export Project.

Concept Enitoy Affinities

Will this Concept Enitoy have one Affinity or two?

Choose Material

Select the Concept Enitoy's Material. This will be stored as Color 1.

Choose Affinity

Select the Concept Enitoy's first Affinity. This will be stored as Color 2.

Choose Second Affinity

Select the Concept Enitoy's second Affinity. This will be stored as Color 3. The Affinity used for Color 2 cannot be selected again.

Add Temperament Lock

Choose a temperament to add. Already selected temperaments are hidden. Maximum: 13.

Add a summonable Enitoy, then set separate Day and Night likelihoods from 0% to 100%.

Modifications

Choose the Enitoy this species can modify into, then choose the method and its parameter. Multiple modification paths are allowed.

Add Name Origin

Name origin for this Enitoy. Enter one piece of the name at a time; the order can be changed later by dragging entries in the Name Origin line.

Fill in all three fields to preview the name origin sentence.

Add Existing Name Origin

Choose a source word already defined on any Enitoy. Each word appears only once here.
